entities.name: Elenda of Garrano
entities.description: Legendary ancestor of the Legion of Dusk vampires on Ixalan, a former warrior nun who took on immortality to recover the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Vampire order descended from Elenda.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Plane of the Legion of Dusk and Sun Empire.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: Early convert of Elenda and a vampire leader who asked her aid to retrieve the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Pedron the Wicked
entities.description: Fiend who raided Elenda's monastery and killed most of its occupants.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact guarded by Elenda's order that was stolen by a winged beast.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: Mountainous home of the monastery and of the vampire nobles.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The city where Elenda found the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: Bat god in whose tomb Elenda slept.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: Ixalan empire that preserved the tale of Elenda as 'The Bat of the East'.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: Awakened the city of Orazca.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: Planeswalker Elenda first met on her return.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Planeswalker who met Elenda and later negotiated an alliance with her.

entities.name: Vona
entities.description: Angry vampire who asked Elenda why she had left them.

entities.name: Queen Miralda
entities.description: Queen Elenda asked to be brought to.

entities.name: Vito
entities.description: Vampire who refused to heed Elenda's message of humility.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: Ally with whom Elenda fought during the invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in whose defense of Ixalan Elenda fought.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Huatli's partner at the alliance negotiation.

entities.name: Caztaca Huicintli
entities.description: Aunt of the child emperor of the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: Admiral who interrupted the meeting demanding support for a free country for the Brazen Coalition.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Pirate faction led by Beckett Brass.

events.summary: Pedron raids the monastery guarding the Immortal Sun; it is stolen by a winged beast and Elenda follows it west.
events.quote: The monastery was raided by Pedron the Wicked , who killed most of its occupants.

events.summary: Elenda resorts to dark magic and immortality, searches for centuries, returns to teach her Rite to nobles, then sails west again.
events.quote: Elenda resorted to dark magic and took on the burden of immortality until the Immortal Sun could be retrieved once again.

events.summary: Elenda finds the Immortal Sun at Orazca and sleeps in a tomb of Aclazotz until the city awakens.
events.quote: she put herself in an enchanted sleep in a tomb of the bat-god Aclazotz

events.summary: Elenda meets Angrath and Huatli and is appalled that the Legion of Dusk became cruel invaders.
events.quote: was appalled to hear that the Legion of Dusk had become cruel invaders in her absence

events.summary: At the Sanctum of the Sun she refuses Mavren Fein's request to retrieve the vanished Immortal Sun, tells the vampires they are free, and rebukes Vona.
events.quote: Elenda refused, telling the vampire that they were finally free from their ancient duty

events.summary: Back in Torrezon Elenda preaches humility and restraint, which some such as Vito refuse to heed.
events.quote: Elenda began preaching a message of humility and restraint

events.summary: Elenda fights alongside Azor in defense of Ixalan during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Elenda fought alongside Azor in defense of Ixalan during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

events.summary: A year later Elenda meets Huatli, Saheeli, and Caztaca to negotiate an alliance; Beckett Brass interrupts demanding support for the Brazen Coalition.
events.quote: The meeting was interrupted by Admiral Beckett Brass

relations.note: He was one of her early converts.
relations.quote: Mavren Fein was one of her early converts.
Elenda survived and ran outside to fight Pedron
